name: battery-log
title: Battery Log
summary: Test patch: records the raw battery value.

actions.title: Clear the Battery Log
actions.status: The battery log is empty. The iPod writes a line at each sample.

steps: Select the time between samples below. Then flash a firmware with this patch.
Click Eject iPod. Then disconnect the iPod.
Play music until the iPod stops.
Charge the iPod and connect it to the Mac.

description: A test. It records the raw battery value at regular times, so that you can see the discharge curve of the battery. The iPod does not need a button press.
details: Each line has the seconds since the start, the raw battery value, the icon value (0 to 20) and the charger state.
The first sample comes 60 seconds after the start. Each start adds the line "start".
The iPod writes each sample to the disk. Thus the log loses very little when the battery becomes empty.
notes: The firmware timer possibly stops when the iPod sleeps or when the backlight is off. A gap in the seconds shows this.

choices.title: 1 minute
choices.description: The most detail. Use this for a short test.

choices.title: 5 minutes
choices.description: Recommended. It shows the fast fall at the end of the battery.

choices.title: 30 minutes
choices.description: The fewest disk writes. It can miss the fast fall at the end of the battery.
